artworks.title: John White, D.D., Minister of Eccles
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man depicted from the waist up, positioned facing the viewer directly. The man's facial features include a closely trimmed beard and mustache, with neatly styled short hair. He wears a cloak with a patterned collar over a robe and holds a small book in his left hand. The background is intricately designed with a decorative ribbon framing his portrait, inscribed with text in Latin both around and below it. The top of the frame features an embellished crest or coat of arms.

artworks.title: Andrew Willet, D.D., Controversionalist
artworks.description: The engraving portrays a man seated at a desk. He is positioned angled towards the left, his left hand on an open book and his right hand holding a quill pen as if writing. The man has a serious expression, a long, pointed beard, straight hair covered with a cap, and is dressed in a fur-trimmed robe over a collared garment. There are two books in front of him, one open and one closed. The background features an oval frame filled with text identifying him as a doctor of theology and scholar, surrounded by geometric patterns. Latin inscriptions and decorative borders adorn the frame, adding to the formal and scholarly atmosphere of the portrait.

artworks.title: John Williams, Archbishop of York, Lord Keeper
artworks.description: This image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up. The man is facing forward with his body slightly angled. He has a composed expression with narrow eyes and large eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a short pointed beard. His hair is straight and combed back from the forehead. He is wearing elaborate clothing with a high lace collar and a dark robe over a lighter fabric. In his right hand, he holds a scroll, while his left hand lightly grasps a closed book. The background features an intricately decorated frame with cherubs and heraldic shields. Latin inscriptions are carved around the border.

artworks.title: John Williams, Archbishop of York, Lord Keeper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in historical attire, seated or standing with his head turned slightly to his left. He has a facial appearance with a mustache and a short pointed beard. He wears a hat with an intricate band, and a ruff collar typical of his era. He is dressed formally in a cloak or robe with a high collar emerging from the ruff, and a doublet or tunic underneath. The man holds a scroll and appears to have a ring on the other hand. Surrounding him is an architectural framework with cherubs, heraldic shields, and decorative motifs, with an inscription detailing his titles and honors. The background has finely crosshatched textures.

artworks.title: Title Page to Observations Upon Caesar's Commentaries by Clement Edmondes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative book title page. The drawing features an elaborate architectural frame surrounding the title "Observations Upon Caesers Cometaries" by Clement Edmundes. The frame is composed of two classical columns topped with detailed pediments including ornate foliage and grape designs. At the top is a medallion with a profile portrait. Below the title is an elegant typeface. On each side of the title are figures in classical attire, with Roman-style armor and draped robes. Each figure gestures towards the title. At the base beneath each figure are intricate carvings of helmets, weapons, and armor. The overall composition exudes grandeur and classical reverence.

artworks.title: John Dee (?)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man. He stands behind a lectern, with his hands on an open book. The man has a beard, mustache, and styled hair. He wears a patterned garment and an elaborate ruffled collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with Latin script and decorative elements. Two winged cherubs are in the top corners of the frame.

artworks.title: Roger Bacon, Friar and Philosopher
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, positioned facing forward with his head turned slightly downwards. He has a serious expression, with detailed facial features including a long beard and a high forehead. His hair is covered by a hood that is part of his robe, which drapes over his shoulders and chest. He is clothed in a textured robe and holds an open book in his hands, which is illustrated with celestial symbols and text. The background consists of a patterned frame around the central image.

artworks.title: John Dee, Astrologer
artworks.description: The image features a bust portrait of an older man, positioned in a seated posture, facing forward. His face is long, framed by a full beard and long hair. He wears a soft, rounded cap on his head. His attire includes a heavy fur-collared coat. The man holds a geometric tool in one hand, which rests on a large sphere. In his other hand, he holds a book or tablet with a geometric design on it. The background consists of a simple, striped pattern, with a decorative frame made of twisted or woven material.

artworks.title: Edward Kelley, Alchemist, Friend of Dr. John Dee
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, holding an open book. He has a beard, mustache, heavy eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and is wearing a cap and dark robe with fur collar. The man's hair is peeking out from under the cap. The book has visible text and symbols. The background has a patterned design with decorative elements. The inscription at the bottom identifies the figure as "Edw: Kelly Prophet or Seer to Dr Dee."

artworks.title: Frederick V, King of Bohemia and Gabriel II, Prince of Transylvania
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals on horseback, their bodies visible from the waist up. The person on the left faces forward, while the person on the right faces slightly to the left. The person on the left has a youthful face with soft features and short, neat hair, topped with a crown. They wear elaborate attire, including a frilled collar and decorated armor, and carry a long scepter. The person on the right has a bearded face and wears a tall, fur-trimmed hat and ornate garments with a high-collared cloak. Both horses are detailed, with the right one adorned with plumes and decorative coverings. The background features an engraved scene of a town labeled "Preßburg" and a river labeled "Danubius Flu," with small figures suggesting a lively environment or a battle scene.

artworks.title: Henry Garnett, His Face in the Miraculous Corn Straw
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious emblem. The central motif features a sheaf of wheat with a face at its base. Surrounding the wheat motif are the letters "IHS," and Latin text encircles the entire image. The text commemorates an event dated Maii 1606. The drawing has an antique quality and a balanced composition that emphasizes the central imagery and Latin text.

artworks.title: Isaac Oliver, Miniature Painter
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man standing, with his right hand on his chest and his left hand holding a small circular object, possibly a medallion. The man has distinct facial features, a mustache, a pointed beard, dark wavy hair, and is dressed in an ornate vest with a detailed pattern. On the table in front of him are miniature portraits and an artist's palette with brushes. In the background, there is a landscape with buildings, hills, and sailboats in a body of water. The image is labeled as Isaac Oliver.

artworks.title: Samuel Purchas
artworks.description: The image features the bust of a man facing forward with his right hand slightly raised above an open book on a desk. He has a medium-length beard and mustache, a high-collared shirt, and a robe fastened with buttons. The background is plain, and the man is framed within an oval surrounded by text and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Horace Vere, Lord Vere of Tilbury
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The person is wearing armor and a hat, with a cape flowing behind them. They hold a baton in one hand. The horse has a decorative harness. In the background, there are buildings and hills. Above the person, to the left, there is a heraldic coat of arms. Text below the image likely describes the person in Latin.

artworks.title: Edmund Geninges, Catholic Priest
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a man from the waist up, seated and facing forward. He wears a distinctive hat and formal attire. He is holding a book with both hands. In the background, there is a crest or coat of arms in the top left corner, surrounded by text in Latin script and ornate borders.

artworks.title: Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: The image shows ten men standing closely together from the waist up. They face each other and appear to be engaged in a discussion. Each man wears a wide-brimmed hat with various decorations. Their facial features include beards or mustaches, and their hair is styled in long, wavy patterns. The men wear period attire reminiscent of Elizabethan or Jacobean styles. The scene likely takes place indoors, as no distinct background is visible. The men's hands are visible, with some gesturing or resting. The text below the image is in Latin and may provide context or identification for the men.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy and the Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of Thomas Percy, a 17th-century historical figure. Percy is shown in an elaborate portrait format, facing slightly left. He has a mustache and beard, with wavy shoulder-length hair under a feathered hat. He wears a high-collared garment with lace detailing. German texts flank him, likely explaining his life or deeds. Below, two smaller circular illustrations show armed men in period military attire. The background is intricately patterned with lines and text.

artworks.title: Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a public execution scene in a historical town setting. The image features an execution platform in the center where a chaotic scene unfolds. The atmosphere is tense, with multiple figures on a raised stage engaged in dynamic movement. Surrounding the central action, the town's architecture consists of tall, pitched-roof houses. A large gathering of onlookers is present, with people on horseback and standing in clusters. In the foreground, some figures appear to have fallen or are lying on the ground. The drawing showcases period costumes, intricate architectural stylings, and careful depictions of figures.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.artist: Attributed to Crispijn de Passe I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the shoulders up, positioned in profile. His head is turned to the side, revealing his facial features which include a prominent nose, a beard, and a mustache. He wears a large, broad-brimmed hat with a decorative band around it. His hair is medium length and curls slightly at the ends, visible beneath the hat. The man is clad in a period costume featuring a doublet with a ruffled collar adorned with intricate lace. The background consists of a highly decorative frame displaying various scenes: "Domus Parlamenti" on the top left, "Palatium Regis" on the right, and other historical or significant events illustrated in roundels at the bottom. The text around the portrait provides historical context related to the figure portrayed, and there is a wooden keg or barrel motif beneath the portrait in the frame's design.

artworks.title: Duke of Alva
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man. Only the upper part of his body is visible, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is positioned in profile, facing slightly to the viewer's right. He has a long beard and mustache, with a forehead mostly covered by his fringe and short, receding hair. His facial features are sharp and defined, with deep-set eyes and a high forehead. He is wearing armor with ornate detailing on the shoulder area and an elaborately decorated collar. A chain with a medal or pendant is around his neck. The background is filled with closely spaced lines for contrast and texture. Text below the image provides historical information about the figure depicted.

artworks.title: William Ames
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing forward with his right hand on his chest and his left hand holding a small book. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and a goatee. His hair is closely cropped and he wears a cap. He is dressed formally in a dark robe with a buttoned front and a large ruff collar around his neck. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines, providing a textured backdrop to the engraved portrait.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image displays a man seated in an ornate chair. He is facing slightly to the right, with his body positioned side-on to a desk. His right arm rests on the table, holding a feather quill poised to write on an open book. The man's facial expression is calm, featuring a mustache and neatly trimmed beard. He wears a tall, structured hat with ruffled edges. His curly hair is visible under the hat, framing his face. He is adorned in elaborate attire, including a richly embroidered cloak with patterned designs, a large ruffled collar encircling his neck, and a hanging medallion. The chair is decorated with carved patterns and tassels. Above him are illuminated words and a laurel. To the right are two shelves displaying books and a coat of arms. An inkwell is placed on the desk next to the open book. The background features detailed curtains and Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a seated man depicted from the waist up. He is positioned at an angle, with his body turned slightly towards a writing desk where he is holding a quill pen poised above a large piece of paper inscribed with text. His facial features show a solemn expression with a neatly trimmed mustache and a pointed beard. He is wearing a tall, flat-topped hat adorned with a band and an elaborate ruff around his neck, and his hair is curly and extends to his shoulders. His clothing is richly decorated, with a patterned, fur-lined cloak draped around his shoulders and a starry motif on the sleeves of his tunic. A medallion hangs from his neck. The background reveals a curtain on the left and a shelf on the right holding several books. There is a coat of arms mounted on the wall next to the shelf. The engraving features an ornate cartouche above the man with Latin text, and another block of text occupies the space below the figure.

artworks.title: Richard Carpenter
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a traditional 17th-century outfit, holding a book close to his chest. Beside him is a smaller scene depicting a figure kneeling before a seated pope, with Latin writings. The man has a long face, prominent eyes, a small mustache, and mid-length hair. The background has a dark, cross-hatched texture with a light beam shining towards him. Below the portrait are English text lines from the Psalms, dated 1641.
